prompt: The camera does not move. Brandon stays frozen with the hammer raised beside his face, his shoulders rising as he sucks in a breath, his eyelids squeezing tighter. Later his raised arm trembles slightly and his weight shifts from one foot to the other. The overhead tube buzzes with a very slight flicker. The camera does not move. Shot at 24fps with a 180-degree shutter, so fast movement smears. Audio: the buzz of the tube light, a slow drip from the tap, a held breath, a floorboard creaking. No dialogue, no music. Thanks.
